project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Nine Mile Metals Acquires the Wedge Project Including the Wedge Copper Deposit Project'.

company_name.justification: The press release is from 'NINE MILE METALS LTD.(CSE: NINE, OTCQB: VMSXF, FSE: KQ9) (the “Company ” or “Nine Mile ”), is pleased to announce it has entered into a Mineral Property Option Agreement...'

ceo_buyer.justification: A quote in the article is attributed to 'Patrick J. Cruickshank, MBA CEO & Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states the agreement is 'to acquire a 100% interest in the Wedge Project from Slam Exploration Ltd. (“SLAM”).'

primary_commodity.justification: The text states, 'The Wedge deposit was considered a Copper deposit...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the correct project, the acquisition of the Wedge Project by Nine Mile Metals. However, no URL was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The cash payment is denoted in '$' and the acquiring company, Nine Mile Metals Ltd., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), implying Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement requires Nine Mile to pay '$150,000 to SLAM, during a period of up to four years' consisting of payments of $10,000, $20,000, $30,000, $40,000, and $50,000 over four years.

share_payments_raw.justification: The agreement specifies payment in a number of shares, not a monetary value of shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement requires Nine Mile to pay 'an aggregate of 1,200,000 common shares' over a period of four years.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.01'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text explicitly states the company 'has not agreed to any minimum exploration expenditures on the Property.'

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text explicitly states the company 'has not agreed to any minimum exploration expenditures on the Property.'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller retains a 2% Net Smelter Royalty, which is part of the transaction terms. The text states: 'The Company may purchase half of the 2% Net Smelter Royalty at any time for the price of $1,000,000.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states, 'The Wedge Property consists of 114 claim units covering 25 km2.' This is the property being acquired from SLAM.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states, 'The Wedge Property consists of 114 claim units covering 25 km2.'
